Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.lang

Class LangException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.lang.LangException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LangException extends RuntimeException
A language error carrying the source position that caused it: an unterminated string from the Lexer, a syntax error from the Parser, or an illegal construct rejected by the compiler.

Positions are 1-based, and line() / column() always point at the offending token rather than at the whitespace after it, which is what lets an editor place the caret exactly where the author has to type. sourceName() is the logical script name (a file path, a buffer title, "<repl>"), never null.

The message is deliberately free-form text; a host that needs structure should use toDiagnostic() (or Mandela.analyze at the API level), which exposes the same information as a severity/position record.

      public LangException(String sourceName, int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, String message)
      Builds a ranged error.
      Parameters:
      sourceName - the logical source name (may be null, then "<script>")
      line - the 1-based start line
      column - the 1-based start column
      endLine - the 1-based end line (0 means "same as start")
      endColumn - the 1-based end column (0 means "same as start")
      message - the human-readable description
